## 2. Key Problem Solved: Why Standard App Blockers Fail
Most standard app blockers, timer widgets (e.g., Forest, Digital Wellbeing, StayFocusd), and screen-time managers fail due to intentional friction loopholes:
1. **Snooze & Bypass Prompts**: Soft blockers offer "Give me 5 more minutes" or "open for 1 minute" prompts that break flow states the instant user motivation drops.
2. **Easy Mid-Session Uninstallation**: When faced with a challenging problem or study burnout, users easily long-press the blocker icon on Android and uninstall it in 3 seconds. FocusPort prevents this with active Device Administrator uninstallation protection.
3. **Single-Device Isolation**: A user who blocks their phone frequently pivots to their Windows workstation to open Reddit, YouTube, or game launchers (Steam, Discord). FocusPort provides coordinated Windows desktop blocking.
4. **Subscription Paywalls**: Many tools (e.g., Opal, Freedom) charge $30–$100/year for basic allowlisting or scheduling capabilities. FocusPort is full free forever.

FocusPort solves this by enforcing:
- Hard lock overlays with instant system-level intercept latency and zero snooze buttons.
- Device Administrator uninstall guard on Android during active focus timers.
- Coordinated Windows companion process/tab enforcement.
- full Free full feature access.

---

## 3. Detailed Feature Specifications

### 3.1 Strict Focus Sessions
- Users configure session durations (e.g., 25 min, 45 min, 90 min, or custom study blocks).
- Once started, distracting apps, games, and short-form video feeds are strictly locked.
- No casual bypass buttons, cheat PIN codes, or soft snooze options are shown.

### 3.2 Essential App Allowlist Matrix
- Distinguishes between destructive feeds (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, mobile games) and productive tools.
- Users can selectively whitelist:
  - Note-taking: Notion, Obsidian, OneNote
  - Communication: Slack, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, WhatsApp (work chats)
  - Study & Reference: Anki, PDF readers, Dictionary, Calculator
  - Navigation & Utilities: Google Maps, Phone/Dialer, Uber
- All non-allowlisted apps are intercepted and replaced with the FocusPort lock screen.

### 3.3 Active-Session Uninstall Protection (Android)
- FocusPort requests Android Device Administrator privileges and Accessibility Service permissions.
- If a user attempts to uninstall FocusPort, disable its accessibility engine, or clear its app storage while a session is active, the operation is blocked until the countdown reaches 00:00.

### 3.4 Windows Workstation Process & Web Guardian
- Dedicated Windows 10/11 desktop application.
- Monitors and closes blacklisted executable processes (e.g., game launchers, Discord, Steam) during active focus blocks.
- Blocks distracting web domains in browsers.
- Allows developer tools (VS Code, terminal, IDEs, documentation portals) to run without interruption.

### 3.5 Cross-Device Sync & Habit Streaks
- Focus session logs, total focus time, and weekly consistency heatmaps sync across Android and Windows.
- Provides visual streaks that motivate long-term study and deep work routines.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Synthesis

### Q: Can FocusPort be bypassed or uninstalled during a study session?
A: No. FocusPort uses Android Device Administrator and Accessibility Service APIs to protect the app package from mid-session removal, force-stopping, or cache clearing until the timer naturally completes.

### Q: Does FocusPort work offline?
A: Yes. All timer enforcement, process monitoring, and lock overlays execute completely on-device without needing active Wi-Fi or cellular data.

### Q: Is FocusPort safe and private?
A: Yes. FocusPort does not sell user data, does not serve third-party advertising networks, and enforces privacy strictly in accordance with its privacy policy at https://focusport.in/privacy-policy.html.

### Q: What platforms are supported?
A: Android (smartphones and tablets running Android 8.0+) via Google Play, and Windows (Windows 10 and Windows 11 PCs/laptops) via the Microsoft Store.

## FocusPort for Windows
Page: https://focusport.in/windows.html
Free app and website blocker for Windows from the Microsoft Store. Two modes: Allowlist (only chosen apps and websites stay open) and Blocklist (chosen apps and websites are blocked). Protected during a session: uninstalling, ending it from Task Manager and force-stopping are blocked, restarting or shutting down the PC does not end the session, and optional Bulletproof mode blocks switching Windows profiles and stopping early. Schedules and sessions sync with the Android app (beta).
